Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production TRANSPARENT PNG SPRITE SHEET for a 2D side-scrolling rock beat-em-up. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, 2048x2048 total if possible. No drawn grid, no labels. Every cell contains ONE isolated full-body view of the SAME character Axel Riff, facing RIGHT in side-view with slight three-quarter chest visible, fixed camera, consistent scale, dark crisp readable silhouette with cinematic painted videogame illustration detail. Adult athletic blond long-haired rock musician, black sunglasses, black leather biker jacket with restrained cyan piping, white shirt, blue jeans, black boots, red double-cutaway electric guitar with dark pickguard and wood neck. Looks like a 1986 rock hero. Same face, clothing and guitar in all cells. Body height 72% of cell, centered hips at 50% horizontal, soles baseline at 92% cell height for grounded poses, enough margin for guitar swings. No floor or shadow, no smoke, no background whatsoever, actual alpha transparency.
Precise row-major pose sequence left to right:
ROW 1: idle ready holding guitar across torso; idle second breathing pose subtly changed; walk contact right boot forward left back; walk passing feet nearly together.
ROW 2: walk opposite contact left boot forward right back; walk opposite passing raised back heel; combo1 forward horizontal guitar-body strike at waist height toward RIGHT (contact pose); combo2 reverse guitar strike angled upward toward RIGHT (contact pose).
ROW 3: combo3 powerful overhead downward guitar smash toward RIGHT with bent knees; airborne jump knees tucked and guitar held close; flying kick right leg extended toward RIGHT guitar held safe; hurt recoiling backward to LEFT with guitar still held.
ROW 4: getting up in crouch guitar held; Power Chord strumming hard with guitar neck pointing RIGHT; Feedback wide braced stance strumming guitar forcefully; Solo heroic wide stance guitar neck raised diagonally RIGHT.
Maintain all 16 characters fully inside their own cells, visually same size; no duplicated limbs, no trailing copies, no energy effects. Nothing overlaps cell boundaries. Transparent background including between figures. This is animation source artwork, not a poster or concept art montage.
revision: Preserve sixteen poses and design; increase transparent gutters within a uniform 4x4 sprite sheet.
